messages:
Laura (AE): Quick procurement preflight for Meridian Labs POC — they signed the order form but procurement pushed back asking for MSA/DPA redlines, PO workflow, and a completed security questionnaire. Also need signature routing for two signers (POC lead + procurement). Can legal/finance/security ops help? Need to confirm billing/proration and whether we can reserve capacity before final signature.

Anna (Sales Ops): Got it. Can you drop the buyer redlines and the order form PDF here? For DocuSign path we usually do: procurement -> legal -> ops -> sales. cc @Sam for billing routing.

Sam (Finance): If they want Net 30 + PO, we can map billing to 'Invoice on acceptance' and set payment terms net30. Confirm AP email (we need to send invoices to AP@meridianlabs.com). For the 30-day PoC — do we prorate or charge full month? Need line-item breakdown to process a PO.

Tony (SE): For the PoC they requested Dedicated capacity: 2x A10G equiv, ~50k tokens/day. Model variant they want is `redwood-compact-v1`. Suggest config (informal): `dedicated.pool=size:small,gpus:2,burst:true,term:30d`. If procurement insists on capacity reservation we'll need a booking hold.

Olivia (Security): Security team needs the completed questionnaire + latest SOC2 report and subprocessors list. If they require SCCs for EU data we can accommodate but legal needs to sign off. I'll create a secure intake link once we confirm their security contact.

Matt (Legal): I'll take the MSA/DPA redlines. What are their primary asks? If they're pushing a 99.99% SLA with financial credits we need to escalate to product/rev ops. Also, we can't accept a 'no subcontractors' clause — we'll provide subprocessors + KMS/HSM commitments. Drop their redline PDF or comments.

Laura (AE): Uploading buyer redlines here: https://files.redwood/sales/meridian/redlines-v1.pdf. AP contact is ops@meridianlabs.com and procurement says PO# 23456 is their reference (pending issuance). They also asked if we can accept the PO now to reserve capacity.

Anna (Sales Ops): I can pre-config the DocuSign envelope. Do we want parallel signatures (procurement + POC lead) or sequential? @Matt, sequential would let legal check before countersignature.

Matt (Legal): Sequential, please. Legal review before countersignature. Also require explicit 'authorized signer' language and email verification. If they ask for a company stamp, we'll need to escalate.

Sam (Finance): Regarding proration: standard is pro rata for mid-month starts. For POCs we can offer a one-time conversion credit of 20% if they convert to an annual contract within 60 days — subject to rev ops approval. I'll confirm with revenue ops and update invoice terms.

Laura (AE): They also asked who is the importer of record for EU region data — sounds like a private deployment ask (VPC/on-prem). Flagging for AE & Solutions to follow up.

Olivia (Security): I'll send the security questionnaire link: https://secure.redwood/sq/meridian-2026 and the SOC2 download link once I have permission to share. Request: please ask them to fill within 3 business days so we don't block provisioning. If they want hosted-only with EU residency, that is doable but may affect lead time.

Anna (Sales Ops): Action items: @Laura upload final redlines and confirm AP email; @Matt to draft response to redlines by EOD tomorrow; @Sam to confirm invoice routing, PO acceptance policy, and credit option; @Olivia to send SOC2 + SQ link; @Tony to confirm capacity hold window and whether we can reserve for a pending signature. I'll draft DocuSign envelope and share once legal okays redlines.

Laura (AE): :thumbsup: One more procurement question — can we accept their PO ahead of signature to reserve capacity? They prefer to issue PO now to hold block. @Sam any objections?

Sam (Finance): We can accept a PO as a 'booking hold' provided we receive countersigned order form within 7 days; otherwise we'll release capacity. I'll add an annotation on the invoice: `Booking hold — countersign required within 7 days or capacity released.`

Anna (Sales Ops): Draft envelope pushed to staging: `docs/docusign/meridian-poc-envelope.v1` — will attach order form + MSA redlines. I'll add `InvoiceRef: MER-23456` to envelope metadata.

Docbot (System): Reminder: upload MSA redlines to CLA tracker: /legal/changes/meridian/1719998888.

Laura (AE): Thanks everyone — I'll collect the final docs today and update. Will post progress tomorrow morning.
